# gpupaas_kubernetes_sku_capacity (Data Source)

The capacity left for a Kubernetes SKU. The API reference does not describe the answer, so it is returned as a JSON document in `json`; read it with `jsondecode`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The capacity left for the Kubernetes SKU. The platform's answer is returned as JSON.
data "gpupaas_kubernetes_sku_capacity" "k8s" {
  project = "system-catalog"
  name    = "mks-oneclick-1"
}

# Not every compute type reports capacity (bare metal does not): `supported` is then false and `json` is null.
output "capacity" {
  value = data.gpupaas_kubernetes_sku_capacity.k8s.supported ? jsondecode(data.gpupaas_kubernetes_sku_capacity.k8s.json) : null
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Kubernetes SKU.
- `project` (String) Project that holds the SKU, usually `system-catalog`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `json` (String) The platform's answer, as JSON. Null when `supported` is false.
- `supported` (Boolean) False when the platform does not report capacity for the compute type of this SKU (for example bare metal): `json` is then null and a warning is shown. Any other refusal is an error.
